mintAuthority.summary: Canonical sUSDx shares are issued against deposited USDx, with pending-request cancellation restoring previously burned shares. Native USDx issuance is inherited from usdx-axis. The wrapper is upgradeable under a separate two-day timelock, while its governance Safe can change accounting and redemption parameters directly.

controls.label: Axis canonical StakedUSDx share accounting

sources.label: Axis synchronous deposits and async redemption accounting
Pinned Ethereum underlying and vault-state reads

controls.evidence: asset() returned canonical USDx at block 26107703, and getVaultState() reported solvent=true with assetBalance equal to requiredAssets. Deposits mint pro-rata shares against USDx; requestRedeem burns shares and reserves assets; cancellation re-mints those previously burned shares. Reward funding transfers USDx before vesting. No unrestricted local share-minter role is documented. This is mint-scoped resolution, not a claim of immutable code or absence of inherited parent issuance.

controls.label: Axis StakedUSDx parameter governance Safe

sources.label: Pinned Safe and vault-admin membership reads

controls.evidence: StakedUSDx.hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, Safe) returned true at block 26107703. The Safe threshold was 3 with five owners, an empty completely paginated module list and a zero standard guard slot. Docs authorize reward, cooldown, servicing-policy and deposit-pause configuration; rescueTokens cannot dip into requiredAssets. These direct admin actions are not delayed by the proxy-upgrade timelock. Full service-role membership and signer independence remain unproved.

controls.label: Axis StakedUSDx proxy-upgrade timelock

sources.label: Pinned Ethereum owner and delay reads

controls.evidence: At block 26107703, the vault's EIP-1967 admin was 0x50606ecc0c9dc5c6b3bf25ffbdd8433730fc46ea and its owner() was the published TimelockController, whose getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds. The implementation slot was 0x1d8191c20c06c5628f1a977bc6d6afe7dd541cf2. A future implementation can replace share accounting and issuance rules; complete proposer/executor and bypass closure is not asserted.

review.evidence: The canonical Ethereum V2 share token and its USDx underlying were reverified at block 26107703, hash 0x1af27eeae8f8788fa7897fa456addc58ffc0e2e5f01befe9a58256167e5aeb9d (October 2, 2026, 22:43:59 UTC). Native parent issuance remains on usdx-axis. Local deposits and request cancellations are asset-backed share accounting, not a privileged base-liability mint path. Upgrade and policy controls remain explicitly reviewed despite mint-scoped none-resolved-mint. The seven-day cooldown is an eligibility threshold, with servicing and claims independently pausable; those holder-exit controls do not imply a separate supply minter.
